tool_args.rationale: Acquire the fine trajectory batch to bring the dataset to at least 8 rows and identify the four coupled ODE parameters using the supplied irregular-history memory initialization and horizon integration.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit coupled two-state memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Only 5 trajectories for 4 fitted parameters, with irregular raw histories and hidden initial memory; source guidance requires at least 8 rows for identification.

Would compare other mechanisms, but the pilot signatures and verified history-conditioned ODE guidance point to the memory-kernel branch; more trajectories are directly needed to identify its parameters.
High variance auxiliary measurement is irrelevant to resolving parameter identifiability.
